mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public_recipes (recipe_id, user_id, average_rating, rating_count, tried_count, favorite_count, fork_count, hot_score, published_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public_recipes WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_ratings (public_recipe_id, user_id, score, comment, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{publicRecipeId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{comment}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), comment = VALUES(comment), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT score, COUNT(*) AS count FROM recipe_ratings WHERE public_recipe_id = #{publicRecipeId} GROUP BY score ORDER BY score
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO recipe_try_records (public_recipe_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{publicRecipeId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT IGNORE INTO recipe_favorites (public_recipe_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{publicRecipeId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipe_favorites WHERE public_recipe_id = #{publicRecipeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_fork_records (public_recipe_id, user_id, source_recipe_id, forked_recipe_id, created_at) VALUES (#{publicRecipeId}, #{userId}, #{sourceRecipeId}, #{forkedRecipeId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE public_recipes SET fork_count = fork_count + 1, hot_score = hot_score + 2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{publicRecipeId}
